ex.en: You shouldn't talk back to your parents like that.
ex.zh: 你不應該對你父母那樣頂嘴。

ex.en: I wrote a letter to my parents at home.
ex.zh: 我寫了封信給家鄉的父母。

ex.en: A parent or teacher should bring home to children the pleasure of reading.
ex.zh: 家長或老師應該讓孩子體會閱讀的樂趣。

ex.en: He's the new CEO from the parent company in France.
ex.zh: 他是來自法國母公司的新任執行長。

ex.en: The parent company owns five smaller brands.
ex.zh: 母公司旗下擁有五個較小的品牌。

ex.en: The party has been put off until next Tuesday.
ex.zh: 派對延到下週二了。

ex.en: There appears to be a party in that house.
ex.zh: 那間房子裡好像在開派對。

ex.en: The organization is not connected with any political parties.
ex.zh: 這個組織和任何政黨都沒有關係。

ex.en: Which party won the election?
ex.zh: 哪個政黨贏得了選舉？

ex.en: Party of four? Please follow me.
ex.zh: 四位嗎？請跟我來。

ex.en: Both parties signed the agreement.
ex.zh: 雙方都簽了協議。

ex.en: Did you get the package that I sent you?
ex.zh: 你收到我寄給你的包裹了嗎？

ex.en: Did Tom get the package we sent to him?
ex.zh: 湯姆收到我們寄給他的包裹嗎？

ex.en: Just put those packages anywhere.
ex.zh: 那些包裹隨便放就好。

ex.en: The hotel offers a weekend package with breakfast.
ex.zh: 飯店推出含早餐的週末套裝方案。

ex.en: The job comes with a good benefits package.
ex.zh: 這份工作有很好的福利方案。

ex.en: The boxes are stacked on wooden pallets.
ex.zh: 箱子堆放在木製棧板上。

ex.en: We ordered ten pallets of paper.
ex.zh: 我們訂了十板的紙。

ex.en: A panel of experts discussed the plan.
ex.zh: 一個專家小組討論了這個計畫。

ex.en: She will speak on a panel about climate change.
ex.zh: 她將參加一場關於氣候變遷的座談。

ex.en: In our opinion, solar panels are a good investment.
ex.zh: 我們認為太陽能板是很好的投資。

ex.en: Since I installed solar panels on my house, my energy bill has been cut in half.
ex.zh: 自從我在房子上裝了太陽能板，電費就少了一半。

ex.en: The participants were for the most part women.
ex.zh: 參與者大部分是女性。

ex.en: All participants must be registered.
ex.zh: 所有參加者都必須報名。

ex.en: There are thousands of participants at today's event.
ex.zh: 今天的活動有上千人參加。

ex.en: The parking lot is free of charge.
ex.zh: 停車場是免費的。

ex.en: We spent a lot of time looking for a parking lot.
ex.zh: 我們花了很多時間找停車場。

ex.en: We have a parking lot for the customers.
ex.zh: 我們有顧客專用的停車場。

ex.en: A passport is usually necessary when you travel overseas.
ex.zh: 海外旅行通常都要用到護照。

ex.en: She was in trouble because she lost her passport.
ex.zh: 她弄丟了她的護照，所以遇到了麻煩。

ex.en: I was asked to show my passport at the border.
ex.zh: 在邊境上，我被要求出示我的護照。

ex.en: He was born in a palace that isn't there any more.
ex.zh: 他出生在一個宮殿裡，那宮殿已經不存在了。

ex.en: The palace was heavily guarded.
ex.zh: 皇宮戒備森嚴。

ex.en: To hide the fact that she's a princess, she disguised herself as a boy and escaped the palace.
ex.zh: 她為了掩飾自己公主的身份，女扮男裝，逃出了皇宮。

ex.en: We will make the payment by bank transfer.
ex.zh: 我們會用銀行轉帳付款。

ex.en: Not being able to carry out payments on time can cause very large losses for the consumer.
ex.zh: 沒辦法按時付款，可能會讓消費者蒙受很大的損失。

ex.en: I knew that Tom was in his office doing paperwork.
ex.zh: 我知道湯姆在辦公室處理文書工作。

ex.en: I spent the whole afternoon doing paperwork.
ex.zh: 我整個下午都在處理文書工作。
